# Vendored libraries

Served from this site so the app does not depend on a CDN at runtime. To upgrade, replace the file, keep the version in the file name, and update the references in the HTML pages and service-worker.js.

| File | Package | License |
|---|---|---|
| supabase-js-2.118.0.umd.js | @supabase/supabase-js 2.118.0 (dist/umd/supabase.js) | MIT |
| qrcode-1.0.0.min.js | qrcodejs 1.0.0 (qrcode.min.js) | MIT |
